readme: The fixture ledger for TestSelfTestOverABreakingFixture (memql#5389, Step 7). NOT the real ledger, which is component/language/reserved.json.
It holds exactly one entry, so the self-test can tell a classifier that reports every deletion from one that reads the ledger.
